curatedMovie.curiosityHook: What will Honey do when an opportunity in a music video comes with an unacceptable demand?
curatedMovie.description: Honey Daniels balances club nights and teaching dance in Harlem with dreams of choreographing hip-hop videos, until a breakthrough director's exploitative demands force a reckoning.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: Energetic hip-hop rhythm paired with emotional drama, moving at a brisk, accessible pace.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: Its music-and-dance setting centers a choreographer navigating a major opportunity while teaching at a Harlem community center.
